Private Function Seen(t As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    s = t.Name & " " & t.Index & " " & t.ChartType & " " & t.HasLegend & " " & t.HasTitle & " " & t.SeriesCollection.Count
    For i = 1 To t.SeriesCollection.Count
        s = s & " " & t.SeriesCollection(i).Formula
    Next
    If Err.Number Then s = s & " E" & Err.Number
    Seen = s
End Function

Private Function Read1(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant, o As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.Sheets.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.Worksheets.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.Charts.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = TypeName(wb.ActiveSheet)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = TypeName(ActiveChart)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    Err.Clear
    For Each o In wb.Sheets
        s = s & "[" & o.Name & ":" & TypeName(o) & ":" & o.Index & "]"
    Next
    Err.Clear
    Read1 = s
End Function

Private Sub Act(ByVal which As Long, wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant)
    Dim t As Object, u As Object, co As Object
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)
    Case 1
        ws.Range("B2").Select: Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)

        ws.Range("A1:B3").Select: Set t = wb.Charts.Add: r = Seen(t)

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws).Name = "Two"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets("Two")).Name = "Three"
    ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    ws.Range("A1").Select
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Act which, wb, ws, r
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v & "|" & Read1(wb)
    Err.Clear
    wb.Unprotect: ws.Unprotect
    Err.Clear
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "|saveE" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
